title: Fixed Hooded Scoop and Pivot Fork Long Dustpan
description: One newly authored complete fixed long-handle hooded-dustpan exterior. A continuous low floor, closed rear and curved polygonal upper hood form a genuine deep front-opening scoop, with full proud side cheeks and a separate finite blunt low entry lip. Two short side pivot stubs meet one whole external U-shaped fork without a bar crossing the inner chamber. A full long upright pole and complete open top grip grow from the fork bridge. This is not the old open-top low-front picking bin with a handle added or the long shallow snow shovel relabelled. All geometry original, three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. The scoop remains fixed mouth-down in a display pose; no brush, debris, sweeping, hinge rotation, sealing, cleaning efficacy, reach, ergonomic, load or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
